name: Being Positive
overview: Scripture teaches that being positive is deeply rooted in trusting and committing our ways to the LORD, who is our strength, rock, and deliverer. By remembering His benefits and loving God with all our heart, soul, strength, and mind, believers can maintain joy and confidence even in challenging circumstances. This positive outlook is further encouraged by the promise of salvation for all who call upon the name of the Lord and the heavenly joy over repentance, highlighting the transformative power of faith and trust in God.
